summary: Iteration 2 review: Edge-Register backend endpoints and frontend integration. 11/11 backend API tests green (test_edges_api.py). Frontend flows verified: Backtester -> KI-Tab renders Edge-Register with 16 active/20 total edges, 'Verlauf anzeigen' toggle expands to 20 rows, admin login via header opens admin-login-modal, recover button visible for admin, edge-activate buttons appear on non-active edges after enabling history, clicking one activates the edge (toast 'Edge reaktiviert ... OOS-Trades wiederhergestellt' shown, row becomes 'aktiv' with 'manuell (Rollback)', previously active row becomes 'abgelöst'). Overview endpoint exposes rules.edge_stale_max/edge_replace_margin/edge_min_trades_ratio. No JS console errors on backtester (only a pre-existing hydration warning about <span> inside <option> in AITraderSeeding day-select, already reported in iteration 1).

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' emitted when Backtester opens. Not caused by Edge-Register work but still present. Same finding as iteration 1.

action_items: Optional (not new): fix legacy AITraderSeeding day-select to avoid <span> inside <option> to remove hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Edges router correctly excludes _id and oos_trades from GET responses; rules object mirrors constants from services.setup_backtest.edges.
Activate endpoint validates asset_class/setup/edge_id (400) and returns 404 for unknown edge_id; admin-guard via Depends(require_admin) confirmed by 403 without token.
Recover endpoint is idempotent (second call imported<=first, total edge count unchanged), matches contract.
Overview rules include edge_stale_max/edge_replace_margin/edge_min_trades_ratio in addition to existing keys.
EdgeRegister.js integration renders active count and total in header; show-all toggle correctly reveals candidate/retired rows; admin-only actions gated on token presence.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing state (16 active/20 total edges). The activate test intentionally rolled back crypto/squeeze_breakout from KI-Rev.23 to some other rev (state-changing as authorized in review request).
context_for_next_testing_agent: State was modified by the activate happy-path test: for crypto/squeeze_breakout a non-active edge was activated (rollback). All edges still present; totals unchanged. If retesting rollback, pick another (class,setup) that still has both active and non-active edges. Do not call /api/ai/playbook/backtest/run or /reset per E1 instructions.
